name: porchlight
description: Daily check-ins for older adults living alone, with family, neighbors and volunteers in the loop. iOS app (Expo) + Node server.

scripts.setup: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix mobile
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,app -c yellow,blue "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm start --prefix mobile"
